buildCommand: npm run gen:content && npx expo export --platform web --output-dir dist

//: Inlined into the bundle at build time and readable by anyone with the
page — which is fine, these are public endpoint URLs. A key must NEVER
go here; that is the whole reason the ASK proxy exists.
EXPO_PUBLIC_ASK_PROXY_URL stays empty until the Cloudflare Worker is
deployed. Empty means ASK falls back to bring-your-own-key rather than
calling a URL that does not answer.

rewrites.//: expo-router builds a single-page app: one index.html, routing done in the client. Without this, /explore or a shared card link 404s on a hard refresh because no such file exists. Vercel serves real files first, so /_expo/* assets are unaffected.

headers.//: Hashed filenames, so they can be cached indefinitely.
index.html must never be cached, or a deploy leaves people on the old bundle pointing at hashed assets that no longer exist.
